expected_text.summary: Mastodon had a significantly higher total post volume than Reddit in 2024, and while their overall trends varied in the first half of the year, both platforms followed a similar pattern of reaching their annual low in September followed by a sharp recovery in October.
key_points: Mastodon recorded a total of 18,000,000+ posts in 2024, which is over ten times the posts volume recorded for Reddit in the same period.
Both platforms experienced their lowest activity of the year in September.
Both platforms saw a significant increase in activity in October, with Mastodon reaching its yearly peak.
Reddit's highest activity occurred at the start of the year in January, followed by a general decline through June.
Mastodon's volume was more volatile throughout the first half of the year, with notable peaks in February and May.

actual_text.summary: Mastodon vastly outpaced Reddit in total post volume throughout 2024, generating roughly 10× more posts per month. Mastodon's 2024 total was approximately 18,384,226 posts versus Reddit's 1,747,996 posts. While both platforms shared a few directional trends — notably a dip in September and a rebound in October — their monthly patterns were not consistently aligned, with Mastodon showing a generally upward trajectory and Reddit exhibiting a more pronounced and sustained decline from January through September before recovering.
key_points: Mastodon 2024 total: 18,384,226 posts; Reddit 2024 total: 1,747,996 posts — Mastodon had ~10.5× higher volume.
Reddit peaked in January (171,016 posts) and hit its lowest point in September (109,334 posts), a ~36% drop over the year before partially recovering.
Mastodon peaked in October (1,785,926 posts) and had its lowest month in September (1,221,939 posts), representing a ~32% trough relative to its peak.
Both platforms shared a notable September dip — Reddit's lowest month and Mastodon's lowest month were both September 2024 — suggesting a possible shared seasonal or external factor.
Both platforms rebounded strongly in October: Reddit rose from 109,334 to 152,815 (+40%) and Mastodon from 1,221,939 to 1,785,926 (+46%).

Mastodon showed a broadly upward trend from March through October (with a mid-year plateau), while Reddit trended downward from January to September before recovering, indicating divergent long-term patterns.
